reviews.title: Look good
reviews.comment: Beautiful fans and good if you’re on a budget, they’re a bit noisy but I don’t mind it. They look good and also feel good, only downside is you do have to daisy chain them and it’s a bit hard to cable manage, but for the price point you can’t beat it.
reviews.author: Angelica Lara

reviews.title: Great Fans for a Great Price
reviews.comment: Running 13x total of these fans (mix of reverse & normal). Been running them pretty consistently & heavily. Noise level is great, look is premium, value for the money is amazing, brightness is perfect, build quality is great, functionality as in control and adjusting is pretty typical and needs to be managed by 3rd party open controller. Overall I highly suggest these fans. Only downside is the fans have 2 wires each so when you have 13x like me you can imagine cables mgmt is tough. Only reason I wouldn’t buy these fans again is if they had a good priced uni-fan that daisy chains them. I haven’t looked if that’s an option yet, but I will after submitting this.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Quiet, powerful, and looks great
reviews.comment: I added this fan to my setup and noticed better airflow right away. It runs quietly, even under load, and the cooling performance is solid. The lighting looks clean and not overdone, and installation was straightforward. A great upgrade if you want better cooling without extra noise.
reviews.author: Viral Fixes Daily

reviews.title: Great Fans
reviews.comment: Great performance for the price and very similar looking to some Lian Li fans at a great price. They don't feel super cheap and I've yet to have any issues with these fans. Airflow is pretty good, noise level is not bad at all. I personally highly recommend these fans if you're looking to try them out in your PC.

reviews.comment: Installed easy wires were not hard to tuck away, and they look great inside my computer case.
